\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 213-216 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R221-first-pass-words-from-chapters-213-216}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a coast and a valley.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to mix, to hide oneself, to obey, to host, to recommend
  \item to suggest, to cough, to tremble, to scream, to vote
  \item flu, a prescription, a pill, a syrup, an ointment
  \item trust, courage, shame, jealousy, surprise
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To mix? (\textbf{mescolare}.) To hide oneself? (\textbf{nascondersi}.) To obey? (\textbf{obbedire}.) To host? (\textbf{ospitare}.) To recommend? (\textbf{raccomandare}.) To suggest? (\textbf{suggerire}.) To cough? (\textbf{tossire}.) To tremble? (\textbf{tremare}.) To scream? (\textbf{urlare}.) To vote? (\textbf{votare}.) Flu? (\textbf{l'influenza}.) A prescription? (\textbf{la ricetta}.) A pill? (\textbf{la pillola}.) A syrup? (\textbf{lo sciroppo}.) An ointment? (\textbf{la pomata}.) Trust? (\textbf{la fiducia}.) Courage? (\textbf{il coraggio}.) Shame? (\textbf{la vergogna}.) Jealousy? (\textbf{la gelosia}.) Surprise? (\textbf{la sorpresa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 217-221 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R221-second-pass-words-from-chapters-217-221}

  \item jealous, proud, nervous, calm, silent
  \item equal, similar, false, free of charge, modern
  \item a T-shirt, stockings, a belt, pyjamas, a pocket
  \item a bakery, a butcher's, a forest, a coast, a valley
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Unfortunately? (\textbf{purtroppo}.) Perhaps? (\textbf{forse}.) Maybe? (\textbf{magari}.) Certainly? (\textbf{certo}.) Really? (\textbf{davvero}.) Jealous? (\textbf{geloso}.) Proud? (\textbf{orgoglioso}.) Nervous? (\textbf{nervoso}.) Calm? (\textbf{calmo}.) Silent? (\textbf{silenzioso}.) Equal? (\textbf{uguale}.) Similar? (\textbf{simile}.) False? (\textbf{falso}.) Free of charge? (\textbf{gratuito}.) Modern? (\textbf{moderno}.) A T-shirt? (\textbf{la maglietta}.) Stockings? (\textbf{le calze}.) A belt? (\textbf{la cintura}.) Pyjamas? (\textbf{il pigiama}.) A pocket? (\textbf{la tasca}.) A bakery? (\textbf{la panetteria}.) A butcher's? (\textbf{la macelleria}.) A forest? (\textbf{la foresta}.) A coast? (\textbf{la costa}.) A valley? (\textbf{la valle}.)
